verdict.rationale: First-party docs show global sending in 40+ currencies, with multi-currency balances that can convert and fund single or batch transfers, plus API-driven business payments. On fees, Wise offers rate locks guaranteeing what the recipient gets, a comparison API for price information and a 'no hidden fees or markups' claim. missing for 10: explicit fee-breakdown documentation for transfers (the no-hidden-fees claim refers to card pay/withdraw), and independent or hands-on corroboration of fee transparency.
